title: Crash when running `alien_cake_addict`example in valgrind

labels.name: C-Examples
labels.description: An addition or correction to our examples

labels.name: S-Needs-Investigation
labels.description: This issue requires detective work to figure out what's going wrong

body:
## Bevy version

0.5 ba2916c45a6dcf23f7c4007e7ef2a6b0df393433

## Operating system & version
Ubuntu 21.04
Valgrind 3.17

## What you did
Running this command
```
cargo run --example alien_cake_addict --release
cp assets target/release/examples -r
valgrind --leak-check=full --num-callers=50 target/release/examples/alien_cake_addict
```
crashes bevy with this message(not always happens)
```
thread 'main' panicked at 'called `Result::unwrap()` on an `Err` value: StateAlreadyQueued', examples/game/alien_cake_addict.rs:308:44
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```
